title: Ringworld
author: Larry Niven
summary: A bored two-hundred-year-old man is hired by a cowardly alien to join an expedition to an enormous artificial ring built around a distant star. The crew includes a fierce feline warrior and a lucky young woman.
readIf: you love hard-science thought experiments and the sense of wonder of exploring a giant structure.
skipIf: you want subtle characters or modern gender politics, since both feel dated.

pairings.reason: Another exploration of a huge, silent alien artefact, in a calmer and more mysterious register.
A modern book that matches Ringworld's love of big physical ideas, with more menace.
